# synology_smb (Resource)

SMB file-sharing configuration. Settings omitted from configuration retain their current DSM values. Changing a service may interrupt existing connections; import existing settings first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_based_share_enumeration` (Boolean) Hide shares according to access permissions; distinct from hiding inaccessible files within a share.
- `durable_handles` (Boolean) Enable durable handles.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable SMB file sharing.
- `local_master_browser` (Boolean) Enable the local master browser.
- `maximum_protocol` (Number) DSM maximum protocol: 0=SMB1, 1=SMB2, 2=SMB2 with Large MTU, 3=SMB3.
- `minimum_protocol` (Number) DSM minimum protocol: 0=SMB1, 1=SMB2, 2=SMB2 with Large MTU, 3=SMB3.
- `ntlmv1` (Boolean) Enable legacy NTLMv1 authentication. Import preserves the current value.
- `oplocks` (Boolean) Enable opportunistic locks.
- `server_signing` (Number) DSM server-signing policy. Preserve the imported value unless the target DSM policy has been verified.
- `smb2_leases` (Boolean) Enable SMB2 leases.
- `transport_encryption` (Number) DSM transport-encryption policy. Preserve the imported value unless the target DSM policy has been verified.
- `workgroup` (String) SMB workgroup name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: smb. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
